decision.reason: The complete current report makes a specific empirical comparison to Wilcox/Baillargeon1998Developmental Science direct narrow ball-ball versus ball-box control means, so this is not background merely because a control condition changed. New primary abstracts positively link that Developmental Science report to the earlier in-press Cognitive Psychology work and confirm its7.5/4.5-month design; the shipped Cognitive Psychology report contains eight experiments across7.5–11.5months, beyond the Experiment3copied here. Neither complete original body was recovered after the bounded16-request pair/supplement investigation. Thus the current direct-control comparison is positive, but whether the7.5-month control observations are independent of, or preliminary/alternate reporting of, empirical comparisons already contained in the whole shipped paper cannot be established from the two abstracts and later current account. The4.5-month extension and distinctDOI/pages alone do not certify a separate additional original for this9.5-month test. Retain the actual report-chain/finding-allocation ambiguity without excluding the control as merely methodological or claiming it is genuinely absent.

corrected_value.title: Genetic variant near IRS1 is associated with type 2 diabetes, insulin resistance and hyperinsulinemia

decision.location: Current Table2, other FPGGWASs; ESMTable2Rungreference and Methods/Discussion, read alongside complete Rungand publisherDupuisoriginals
decision.reason: The complete current report selects rs2943641from the explicitly identified Rung2009catalogue report, places it under other FPGGWASs with reportedP=.05, and empirically tests its local LDproxies for continuous log-FPG in927new non-diabetic African-Americans. Complete Rungmain/supplement primary tables actually report continuous FPGtests, including DESIRadditiveP=.05, despite the title emphasizingT2Dand its overall prose reporting noFPGassociation. Retesting a published null/boundary test is eligible; neither a positive prior effect nor exact-SNP numerical recovery is required. The current matching benchmark and source attribution establish an empirical locus/trait retest, not only T2Dmechanism discussion. The represented873Dupuisreport supplies the separateMAGICbenchmark; current16MAGIC versus other-GWASselection and RungESMidentity distinguish the targeted reports. Newly inspected Dupuisbody/publisher57-page supplement and two-sheet study-characteristics workbook report IRS1rs4675095FI/HOMA-IR and rs2943641FI/HOMA-IR, not the specific RungDESIRFPGcomparison used here. SharedDESIR/Inter99cohort names do not make those analyses alternate reports of this original trait/model finding. All supplied shipped/corrected identities and sibling loci checked; no extra pair from DOI/year differences alone. ExactNIHMSsupplement3and byte/version equivalence to publisher alternatives remain unverified; no absence claim about every unseen supplementary statistic is made or needed to identify the positively named Rungtest. The proxy/allele-phase differences and originaltable/prose tension preclude an outcome inference here; outcome remains unrequested. Current source prints no originalDOI, so none added from outside metadata.
